method: TinyFish fetch_content, logged out. Reel pages (/<handle>/reel/<code>/), embed pages (/p/<code>/embed/) for covers and exact like counts, reels/profile grid for views. Discovery beyond the 12-tile grid via web search and the archive.org URL index.

profile.name: Creature
profile.bio: Just a dude making 3D animations (Makeship Salem plush petition + 2 more links)
profile.source: main profile grid (12 posts) + embed pages, logged out 2026-11-22; reels tab is login_required

field_notes.date: UTC timestamp from the page (published_date). date_og is the date in the og:description (US time), so it can be one day earlier.
field_notes.likes: Best available count. likes_page_display is what the page/grid shows; likes_exact_embed_or_og is the exact count from the embed page or og:description. For some humoranimations0 reels from 2025 the page shows noticeably more than the exact embed count (see notes).
field_notes.views: Only available from the reels grid tiles (first 12 reels). null elsewhere.
field_notes.top_comments: Up to 5 most-liked of the ~12 comments Instagram shows to logged-out viewers (not the global top comments). GIF/sticker-only comments skipped. No usernames.
field_notes.comments_mention_ai: True if any visible comment mentions AI (AI/ai/인공지능/ChatGPT...). ai_comments lists them; check context, some are about AI in the story rather than the animation.
field_notes.cover_url: Signed CDN URL that was downloaded; these expire after a few days. og:image from the reel page is cut at 500 characters by the fetcher and cannot be used.
